7: Fuel tanks are pressurized to flight levels
6: The onboard computer takes control over the countdown and runs last checks
8: Launch director verifies go for launch
9: Start of the engine ignition sequence
10: First upwards movement of the rocket
13: Separation of the second stage from the first
14: First start of the second engine
16: Start of the atmospheric entry burn
17: End of the atmospheric entry burn
20: First cut-off of the second engine
18: Start of the first stage landing burn
107: Flip maneuver of the first stage
39: Start of the booster boostback burn
40: End of the booster boostback burn
41: Dragon separates from the second stage
42: Start of the opening sequence of Dragon's nosecone
108: Start of propellant loading in the first stage
109: Start of propellant loading in the second stage
259: Flip maneuver of the side boosters
112: Start of the boosters boostback burn
113: End of the boosters boostback burn
114: Start of the boosters atmospheric entry burn
115: End of the boosters atmospheric entry burn
116: Start of the boosters landing burn
36: Retraction of the crew access arm from the rocket
37: Dragon's launch escape system is armed
87: Start of liquid methane loading in the first stage
86: Start of liquid methane loading in the second stage
88: End of propellant loading in the first stage
89: End of propellant loading in the second stage
90: Activation of the flame deflector ahead of engine ignition
78: Start of the payload deployment sequence
